transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because for the last few weeks, I’ve just barely had an appetite. Usually after a long shift I'm pretty ready to eat, but lately... even foods I normally like just sit there in front of me. I basically have to force down a few bites just to have something in my stomach. It's just been going on for a while now, so I figured I should come in.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the last few weeks?

Yeah, I have. Most days lately, I just feel like I’m carrying this... this heavy, flat feeling around with me. It's like, even when I’m home with my family or just sitting in the break room at work, I’m just not really there. I just feel down most of the time.
Have you been feeling fatigued or lacking energy most days lately?

Not really, no. I mean, working security, the shifts can get pretty long, so I get the regular kind of tired from that. But I wouldn't say I've been feeling extra fatigued or anything. I still have my normal energy to get through the day... it's just that heavy feeling I mentioned.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to focus, think clearly, or make decisions lately?

Yeah, I actually have. It's been pretty noticeable at work. When I’m watching the CCTV feeds or trying to write up my incident reports, my mind just kind of... drifts. I find myself having to reread things over and over again just to process it. It's frustrating because it's actually led to me making a few mistakes lately that I normally wouldn’t make.
Have you lost any weight recently without trying, or has your lack of appetite led to eating significantly less than usual?

Yeah, actually, that's a big part of why I decided to come in. For the last few weeks, I’ve barely had an appetite at all. Even when I get off a long shift and try to eat something I usually like, it just sits there. I end up just forcing down a few bites because I know I need to eat, but I'm definitely eating a lot less than usual.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or have been blaming yourself for things more than usual lately?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't really feel worthless or anything. I mean, I get frustrated with myself when I mess up a report at work because I can't focus, but I don't think I'm blaming myself for things more than normal. It's just the regular amount of beating yourself up when you make a mistake, you know? But nothing extreme.
Just to clarify, have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past 2 weeks or more?

Yeah, I have. Most days I just feel like... well, like I’m carrying this heavy, flat feeling around with me. It's been pretty much every day lately. Even when I’m home with my family or just sitting in the break room at work, I feel like I’m just not really there.
Have you found it hard to think clearly, concentrate, or focus on tasks lately?

Yeah, definitely. It's been really noticeable at work. When I’m watching the CCTV feeds or trying to write up my incident reports, my mind just... drifts off. I find myself having to reread the same lines over and over again just to understand what I'm looking at. That's actually how I ended up making those mistakes on my reports that I mentioned earlier. I just can't seem to keep my focus where it needs to be.
Have you found that you don’t take much pleasure or interest in things you normally enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with family?

Yeah, that's been happening too. I used to really look forward to my morning runs, and I'd play my guitar or cook dinner for the family. But lately... I just keep skipping all of it. They don't feel enjoyable anymore. It just feels like a chore, you know? I just can't seem to get myself to care about doing any of it right now.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling more restless or fidgety lately?

Yeah, I have. Mostly the moving slower part, not really the restless stuff. At work, some of the guys have actually noticed it. During our shift briefings, they've pointed out that I'm moving slower than usual. And I've noticed I'm taking a lot longer to answer when someone talks to me. It just feels like... well, like my body and my mouth are both a step behind everybody else.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things, or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?
No, this is the first time. I've never really felt like this before, where everything just feels so heavy and I don't care about the things I usually like. It's all new to me.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt down and lost interest in things for more than two weeks, or is this the first time you’ve experienced something like this?
Like I was just saying, no, I haven't. This is definitely the first time. I've never had a stretch like this before, not for two weeks or... or any amount of time, really. It's all brand new to me.
Have you ever had any other periods in your life where you felt down or lost interest in things, even if they didn’t last as long as this one?

No, not really. I mean, everybody gets sad or has a bad day here and there, but nothing like this. Never anything where I just stopped caring about stuff altogether. This is the only time it's been like this.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this where you felt down most of the day, lost interest in things, or had similar symptoms that lasted for several weeks or more?

Doc, I... I feel like I'm repeating myself here. But no, I haven't. Like I just said, I've never gone through anything like this before. Not for a few weeks, not at all. This is the very first time I've ever dealt with feeling this way.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt unusually high, extremely energetic, or so good that you didn’t feel you needed much sleep, even for just a few days?

No, I can't say I have. I mean, working security, my sleep schedule can get a little thrown off sometimes, but I've never felt... extremely energetic or unusually high like you're saying. I definitely need my sleep. So, no, nothing like that either.
